title: KreditBee Enters Unicorn Club with $280M Funding Round at $1.5B Valuation
summary: Fintech lender KreditBee becomes India's 3rd unicorn of 2026 following Juspay and Neysa, securing $280M pre-IPO funding.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 KreditBee Enters Unicorn Club with $280M Funding Round at $1.5B Valuation. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Bengaluru-based consumer lending platform **KreditBee** entered the Unicorn club ($1B+ valuation) following a $280 million pre-IPO funding round led by Motilal Oswal Alternates, Hornbill Capital, and MUFG-backed Dragon Funds.
**2026 Unicorn Tally**: 3rd startup to hit unicorn status in 2026 after **Juspay** (Jan 2026) and **Neysa** (Feb 2026).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
